vision: AI-powered LinkedIn banner designer that creates stunning professional banners in seconds using multi-LLM orchestration and voice-powered workflows

target_audience.primary: Career-focused professionals in the Careersy Community who need professional LinkedIn banners to enhance their personal brand
secondary: Content creators needing social media banners for multiple platforms
Small business owners wanting professional branding materials
Job seekers looking to stand out with polished LinkedIn profiles
Marketing professionals managing client social media presence
